First pair:
\[
(\sqrt5+\sqrt6+\sqrt7)(-\sqrt5+\sqrt6+\sqrt7)
=(\sqrt6+\sqrt7)^2-5=8+2\sqrt{42}.
\]

Second pair:
\[
(\sqrt5-\sqrt6+\sqrt7)(\sqrt5+\sqrt6-\sqrt7)
=(\sqrt5-(\sqrt6-\sqrt7))(\sqrt5+(\sqrt6-\sqrt7))
=5-(\sqrt6-\sqrt7)^2
=5-(13-2\sqrt{42})
=2\sqrt{42}-8.
\]

Thus the product is
\[
(8+2\sqrt{42})(2\sqrt{42}-8)
=(2\sqrt{42})^2-8^2
=168-64=104.
\]

\[
\boxed{104}
\]
